note: 2026-11-27. voc:A1:lieb taught the verb, not the adjective: both examples were lieben (the imperative «Lieb mich!» and «Ich liebe es!»), and the gloss «lovable» is the rarest of its senses. It is often the first word a cold visitor meets (top 500, A1). Replaced with the two uses a learner meets every week: «lieb von dir» and the letter closing «liebe Grüße».

rows.de: Das ist sehr lieb von dir.
Viele liebe Grüße an deine Eltern!
